Shopian Police Attach Property and Freeze Cash in Drug Case

Shopian police in Jammu and Kashmir have attached property and frozen cash as part of an investigation into a Narcotic Drugs and Psychotropic Substances (NDPS) Act case. The attached assets are believed to have been acquired through proceeds from drug trafficking. The action was taken by the Shopian police.
